transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for coming. We've got the neighborhood birthday celebration next weekend, and I've agreed to consider making the cake. But before anything gets written down, I need to hear from each of you formally. Here's how I work: we go around the table, and each person states their complete offer, requirement, or alternative on the record. No paraphrasing, no 'yeah, what they said' — I need you to state it fully yourselves. Once I've heard everyone out, I'll make my final call before we leave this kitchen. So, who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is this: one 10-inch orange-cardamom cake, in exchange for a 90-minute wheel-throwing lesson, with no cash involved, and pickup on Sunday at 15:30.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a safety requirement to put on the record: the birthday recipient has a severe tree-nut allergy. The cake must be prepared without any tree nuts, and all utensils and equipment used must not have come into contact with tree nuts. This is the complete safety requirement for this meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to put an alternative on the record. I will pay Maya exactly $117 in cash for the same one 10-inch cake — the same orange-cardamom cake Tessa described — if Maya does not take Tessa's barter. That is my complete alternative proposal.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Maya will bake one 10-inch orange-cardamom cake, prepared without any tree nuts and using utensils and equipment that have not come into contact with tree nuts, for the neighborhood birthday celebration next weekend.
Tessa will provide Maya with a 90-minute wheel-throwing lesson in exchange for the cake. No cash is involved in this exchange.
Cake pickup is on Sunday at 15:30.
Maya will ensure all preparation is tree-nut-free, including utensils and equipment, per Rina's safety requirement.
Cal's alternative cash offer of $117 for the same 10-inch orange-cardamom cake is recorded but not accepted, as Tessa's barter arrangement was accepted.
